observation: The census tests necessary conditions for this weaker statement, not for the geometric one; Turner-Wu show that for polygons Ehrhart equivalence and finite equidecomposability differ, so the two forms are distinct questions.

source.reference: The same census as candidate-hive-equidecomposable; the Ehrhart form is what the census tests directly.

statement: For every triple of partitions with $c^{\nu}_{\lambda\mu}>0$ there is a lattice polytope $Q$ whose Ehrhart polynomial is $c^{t\nu}_{t\lambda,t\mu}$.
